title: Class vs Object
instructions: What is the relationship between a class and an object?

options.text: A class is a blueprint; an object is created from that blueprint
An object is a blueprint; a class is created from it
Classes can only have functions, objects can only have properties

explanation: A class defines what properties and behavior something has — like a design plan. An object (also called an instance) is a specific thing built from that plan. You can create many objects from one class, each with its own property values.
